A.design: Refit taskblind k1/4/8 query prototypes and routing means using first4 lexicalpairs, one template only. Evaluate last4 pairs on BOTH templates. All3 seeds, live gates, joint3heads and donor-bus controls. Uncovered cluster distances fall back to pooled training distance; globally absent distances use0. Context baseline reuses fit-template absolute-position means, absent positions0. No evaluation fit or outcome selection.
